aviation_incidents.headline: 沙烏地哈立德國王國際機場遭襲 外交部：1名臺籍民眾受傷
aviation_incidents.summary: （中央社記者楊堯茹臺北13日電）沙烏地阿拉伯哈立德國王國際機場遭襲擊。外交部今天表示，1名臺籍民眾受波及受傷，臺灣駐處已前往探視及提供協助。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Saudi airport attack injures one Taiwanese national, foreign ministry says
aviation_incidents.summary_en: TAIPEI (Central News Agency) - One Taiwanese national was injured in the attack on Saudi Arabia's King Khalid International Airport, Taiwan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs said on October 13, adding that the representative office had visited the person and offered assistance.
entities: 駐沙烏地阿拉伯代表處

aviation_incidents.headline: 達美航空234號班機在本古裏安機場（TLV）受檢，未發現可信威脅
aviation_incidents.summary: 達美航空表示，234號班機在本古裏安機場落地後，乘客下機，並由當地主管機關檢查，以評估潛在安全疑慮。以色列媒體曾報導，該班機因炸彈威脅而被隔離；達美航空表示，檢查未發現可信威脅，乘客與機組員均安全送往航廈。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Delta Flight 234 inspected at Ben Gurion Airport (TLV); no credible threat found
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Delta Air Lines said Flight 234 was deplaned after landing at Ben Gurion Airport (TLV) and inspected by local authorities to assess a potential security issue. Israeli media reported that the aircraft had been isolated following a bomb threat. Delta said no credible threat was found, and customers and crew were transported safely to the terminal.

aviation_incidents.headline: 澳洲航空羅馬飛伯斯航班因牀蝨取消 波音787留場深層清潔
aviation_incidents.summary: 澳洲航空（Qantas）取消一班由羅馬飛往伯斯的航班，原因是旅客反映在該架波音787夢幻客機前一段服務中遭牀蝨叮咬。報導指出，該架波音787夢幻客機因此留在羅馬。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Qantas cancels Rome-Perth flight after bedbugs reported on Boeing 787
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Qantas cancelled a flight from Rome to Perth after passengers reported bedbug bites sustained on the aircraft's previous service. The airline was forced to ground a Boeing 787 Dreamliner in Rome after passengers reported bedbug bites during a long-haul flight from Perth, Australia.

aviation_incidents.summary: 紐倫堡機場（NUE）於2026年10月13日在當局接獲通報後暫停航班作業；通報稱，一架自希臘科孚島（Corfu）飛抵的Corendon Airlines客機可能發生空中緊急狀況。德國空軍Eurofighter戰機護送客機前往機場，該機安全降落。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Corendon Airlines jet escorted to Nuremberg amid reported in-flight emergency
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Nuremberg Airport (NUE) suspended flight operations on October 13, 2026, after authorities received a report of a possible in-flight emergency aboard a Corendon Airlines passenger aircraft arriving from Corfu, Greece. German Air Force Eurofighter jets escorted the aircraft to the airport, where it landed safely.

taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Estonian Defense Minister Martin Herem said Estonia should consider acquiring light jet aircraft to intercept Russia’s jet-powered long-range attack drones. The remarks appeared in an interview published on October 11, 2026.

international_aviation.headline: NASA據報接觸前SR-71工程人員探討重返飛行
international_aviation.summary: 《Aviation Week》報導，NASA已接觸多名前SR-71工程人員，詢問是否能協助讓飛機重返飛行。報導指出，這架飛機名為NASA 844，最後一次飛行是在1999年10月9日。
international_aviation.headline_en: NASA reportedly contacts former SR-71 engineers about possible return to flight
international_aviation.summary_en: Aviation Week reported that NASA had approached former SR-71 engineers about helping return the aircraft to flight. The aircraft, known as NASA 844, last flew on 9 October 1999, according to the report.

international_aviation.headline: 棕櫚泉航空博物館安排五場活動開放民眾參觀迪士尼私人飛機
international_aviation.summary: 棕櫚泉航空博物館安排在October 2026至April 2027間舉行五場特別晚間活動，讓一般民眾進入華特迪士尼私人飛機內部參觀。報導指出，不屬於迪士尼官方D23粉絲組織的民眾也可參加，活動將在加州棕櫚泉航空博物館舉行。
international_aviation.headline_en: Palm Springs Air Museum schedules five public tours inside Disney’s Gulfstream I
international_aviation.summary_en: The Palm Springs Air Museum has scheduled five special evening events between October 2026 and April 2027. The events will allow members of the general public who are not part of Disney’s official D23 fan organisation to experience the interior of Walt Disney’s last personal aircraft at the museum in California.

international_aviation.headline: Jet2撤出La Palma 取消曼徹斯特服務並放棄斯坦斯特德航線
international_aviation.summary: Jet2表示，檢視飛航計畫及顧客需求後，決定撤出La Palma的航班與假期。該公司取消曼徹斯特（Manchester）—La Palma服務，也放棄原定由倫敦斯坦斯特德（London Stansted）開辦的航線；斯坦斯特德服務尚未啟航。
international_aviation.headline_en: Jet2 withdraws from La Palma, cancelling Manchester and planned Stansted flights
international_aviation.summary_en: Jet2 said it is withdrawing flights and holidays to La Palma after reviewing its flying programme and customer demand. The decision cancels the Manchester service and abandons a planned route from London Stansted. Jet2’s last scheduled Manchester–La Palma flight is due to operate on 30 October; the service began on 3 April.

international_aviation.headline: 航空公司公佈2026/27冬季新增航線與復飛計畫
international_aviation.summary: 航空公司正為2026/27冬季推出新航線；報導所列項目也包括季節性航班與復飛，開航日期仍可能變動。冬季航空季自2026年10月25日至2027年3月27日。聯合航空是新增航線的業者之一。
international_aviation.headline_en: Airlines outline new and returning routes for winter 2026/27
international_aviation.summary_en: Airlines are preparing new services for the 2026/27 winter season. The route selection also includes seasonal services and resumptions, and launch dates remain subject to change. The winter aviation season runs from 25 October 2026 to 27 March 2027. United Airlines is among the carriers adding routes.
